# `gh-tmpl completion`

- **Usage:** `gh-tmpl completion <shell>`

Print a shell completion script for the gh-tmpl binary.

gh does not complete the commands of extensions, so the script completes
gh-tmpl when the binary is on your PATH. The binary answers each completion
request itself; the script needs no other tool.

## Arguments
- **`<shell>`** — The shell

  **Choices:** `bash`, `zsh`, `fish`, `nu`, `powershell`

## Examples

```
gh-tmpl completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_gh-tmpl
```
